summary:
Reviewed w199's 4 commits (be4e1c7c, 36c7061f, e17b2b0f, a853a2ea on HEAD; rebased from the hashes the results list, with the same code).
Removed tests: 16 deprecated scenarios, all in Retires, and the step definitions only they used. None weakened. The one allowance (researcher_asks, setup) holds.
Two Important findings, both fix now. Both come from removing the status gate without carrying out the rest of r129 and r131:
(1) supervise_brief.py:132 still keeps only a DONE researcher's questions. A researcher giving QUESTION or BLOCKED with questions moves w1 to researched, and its questions are lost.
(2) supervise_rounds.py:127-154: an apply round's questions are dropped, and an apply round with no change list moves p1 to approved.
Minor: 'gave DONE' wording in round errors; an unsorted import (ruff I001) in test_supervision.py; intake with no output just ends (open case).
vulture clean; no import contracts; size: nothing over 300.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_brief.py:132: research_questions keeps only a DONE researcher's questions, but outcome() now moves a researcher with questions of any status to researched, so a QUESTION/BLOCKED/PARTIAL researcher's questions are lost (r129, r133; the person's answer and plan part 2 asked for this edit)

Important, scripts/supervise_rounds.py:127-154: with the DONE gate removed, an apply round's questions are dropped (asked=None) and an apply round with no change list moves p1 awaiting-answer -> approved, against r129 and r131 (plan part 2 and decision 2 named the change)
